options.name: acct_port
options.description: Alternate UDP port for RADIUS accounting or keyword 'default'.

options.name: address
options.description: Address or name of the radius or tacacs host.

options.name: auth_port
options.description: Alternate UDP port for RADIUS authentication or keyword 'default'.

options.name: encrypt_type
options.description: The state of encryption applied to the entered key. O for clear text, 7 for encrypted. Type-6 encryption is not supported.

options.name: host_timeout
options.description: Timeout period for specified host, in seconds or keyword 'default. Range is 1-60.

options.name: key
options.description: Shared secret for the specified host or keyword 'default'.

options.name: server_type
options.description: The server type is either radius or tacacs.

options.name: state
options.description: Manage the state of the resource.

options.name: tacacs_port
options.description: Alternate TCP port TACACS Server or keyword 'default'.
